steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I can see the Rathaus spire from here! Thank goodness, it looks like everyone's safe!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Lisa, hurry!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Wh-what happened? Is there a fire?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: My sons haven't come back. Has anyone seen them?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Where are the Gendarmerie?! Where is Severin?! Isn't he supposed to be a hero? And he's missing at a time like this?!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Everyone's panicking!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But it looks like they haven't attacked the residential areas. Someone must be leading them!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Everyone's been on edge for far too long. That explosion was all they needed to snap—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Over here! We have to make sure the Rathaus is secure!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Look! There's a lot of them! Hurry!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hah?!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Not bad for a man your age. Must be nice to live without the constant torment of Oripathy, huh?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Sure... If I gave up smoking in my younger days, you and your friends would be sharing a jail cell by now.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Get out of here. Out of respect for you as my fellow townsfolk, I won't—

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hah! Look at the mouth on this one! You think we don't know you're the last cop in Wolumonde?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Severin! The jig is up. Let us into the Rathaus so we can run our town already.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What do you plan to do?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hah?!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Settle down. Truce. I'm going to smoke a cigarette while you tell me what exactly you want from this town. Go ahead.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Maybe Wolumonde can consider your demands.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: What are you trying to pull?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Look, I'm putting down my sword. I think we can come to terms here. No need to fight.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hah. Now you decide to be reasonable?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Hand over the murderer. And abandon your prejudices.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: ...I want to go home. And I want my job back. Simple enough?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I just need you to fill out a report, and submit to regular physicals. Simple enough.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: That's it?! You walled us in and left us to die!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: All that's left of my block is a heap of earthquake rubble. It's all Originium clusters that could blow at any moment. You evacuated all the non-infected and we're running out of supplies. Is anyone coming to help us?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Oh right, I almost forgot. Because you suck at your job, Wolumonde is heading straight to hell, and we're just the first ones to be thrown under the bus.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: You still think you're so bright, hiding the truth to 'maintain order?'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Looks like my matches got wet. I guess I don't have a light. Let's get back to it.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Wha?! Hand-to-hand?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Sure. Just a quick whiff of tobacco is enough to pump me up.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But, I'm sorry to say, we may be about to have an 'accident' here.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Damn it, let go! Are... Are you trying to kill me? Gah—!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No, just a 'slip' of the hand—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Finished. There were only a few of them, and the rest ran off, leaving this poor fella alone.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Did you kill him?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I don't think so.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It would be nice if the good doctors could wake him up.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: He's breathing!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let's make sure we're saving lives now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'll have words for you soon, 'Schultz.'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Sure. I'm all ears, Miss.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Sir...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I told you before, I'm not 'Sir.' I'm not your Schultz when we're alone. I'm Thor's father, and your uncle.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: No, Sir, you just... you were going to kill that Infected man.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I won't deny it.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: That's only going to make things worse! And you can't attack a member of the Wolumonde family so lightly!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Even if he told the militants that we're defenseless?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You know what this means, Tatjana.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: You should have a heart, at least—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Can't always make the right choice, no matter how much you might want to. Not unless you're omniscient.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Objectively speaking, if a prophet or a banker baron told me just a few deaths would bring peace back to Wolumonde...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'd do it. No matter who had to die.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: ...Even if...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No. Matter. Who.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...At least he managed to hold on to his life. That's good enough.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Let's get back to Rhodes Island. Did you tell them the truth? Did you already take them to the camp? That girl had a different look in her eye.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: You already knew...?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I was pretty sure. For what it's worth, I never saw the point in hiding it from them. But keeping it under wraps myself calmed a lot of people down.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What's your read on them?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I think they'll help Wolumonde. They're the same kind of people as Dr. Atro.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*, *hack*. And you think they speak for all of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They're the ones they sent. So I guess they should be decently representative?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Truth be told, if every Rhodes Island operator we ran into turned out to be a good person, that would disturb me a lot more.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'm thinking back... to a certain sniper. She was from Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The one who came with Dr. Atro and left shortly thereafter?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I hope she didn't get swallowed up by the Catastrophe...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Wh-what? Another attack?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: At this point, every bandit for miles must know we have no Gendarmerie here.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: So what can we do? Get down on our knees and beg for mercy? Or fight to the bitter end?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: No, those explosions are coming from... underground?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Severin! They're over at the workshops! They came through a tunnel on the next street over!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They crippled the main power plant!
Look at it. A beautiful, empty town.
Wolumonde. Moon of the Winterwisp Mountains. Yes, truly worthy of its name.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: A moon? Pfah!

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Four of our people died in that fire.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: And they have the gall to try to pin it on the Infected? What's next? Where do they go from here?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Do they just expect us to turn the other cheek?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're quite worked up. Try to relax. You don't usually talk like that.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: We should level this place! Damned Wolumonders! Damned immigrants!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Mudrock! You and your Sarkaz could do it!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're right... Who knows the pain of losing one's home better than the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Even in Leithanien, where the Infected are supposed to be able to do what they can with what they have, there is no place for the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...But, the cupcakes that nice granny gave us were delicious. Just the right amount of sweet.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So... We wait. The only thing we're here to destroy is the murderer. We can't lose control of our hate. Or else...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What separates us from what we were before?
